title: The UK CMA opens a probe into whether Meta imposed exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers to use their content to develop its AI and other services (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: The UK CMA opens a probe into whether Meta imposed exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers to use their content to develop its AI and other services — Britain's competition regulator on Friday said it has opened an investigation into whether Meta (META.O) was imposing exploitative terms …
